content: Phentermine reduces sedation, but the effect of its interaction with other drugs is unclear, so caution is advised. Serious interactions may occur with nortriptyline and phentermine, requiring alternative medications. Tricyclic antidepressants can either increase or decrease the effects of sympathomimetics by altering norepinephrine reuptake or blocking the uptake of indirect sympathomimetics into adrenergic neurons.
